visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video uses a split-screen screen layout. The top right corner shows a male creator wearing glasses and a headset, dressed in a lavender t-shirt, sitting in a room with a professional microphone and shelving in the background. The rest of the screen displays mobile MOBA gameplay (Arena of Valor) with a top-down perspective of a character moving through a jungle map. (2) Gameplay intensifies as the hero character, Florentino, engages in rapid combat sequences. The visuals are filled with colorful skill effects, health bars, and floating damage numbers. The commentator in the inset maintains a focused expression, occasionally gesturing with his hands. The game map shows lush greenery and stone structures. (3) A fast-paced montage follows, showcasing various triple kills and tactical plays across different parts of the map. Visual highlights include golden outlines on characters and complex particle effects during team fights. The creator is seen smiling and touching his chin while continuing his commentary on the play.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear male voice begins a fast-paced Mandarin commentary with an excited and confident tone. An upbeat electronic background track with a prominent synth beat plays continuously. Sharp digital pings and 'whoosh' sounds from game UI and character abilities are layered over the narration. (2) As a fight occurs, the commentator's pitch rises and his speech rate increases. Numerous percussive 'hit' and 'impact' sound effects from the game fill the acoustic space. The BGM remains steady, providing high-energy support. The overall mix is clean with no audible noise. (3) The audio shifts into a celebratory narrative tone as the speaker describes a successful play. A dense cluster of skill-related SFX occurs during a multi-hero engagement. The speaker's volume remains projected and authoritative until the end, where the music fades out alongside his voice.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Strategic Demonstration -> Combat Highlights -> Tactical Commentary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase high-skill gameplay of the character Florentino in Arena of Valor while providing instructional commentary for viewers. The video serves both as entertainment for gaming fans and a short-form tutorial for players looking to improve their mechanics.
